experiment: Read-only anchored-pressure priority audit on an explicitly bounded exploratory panel

panel.selection: Target case plus three previously discussed teaching/failure seeds; not unseen validation.

candidate_definition.formula: q_all(I)=sum(4-len(D(s)) for distinct incident shore identities, INCLUDING singleton shores)
candidate_definition.active_unit: At least one unresolved shore. Fully named units still leave the queue.
candidate_definition.selected_side: Unchanged first unresolved geometric occurrence, not a global MRV selector.
candidate_definition.selected_name: Unchanged existing-name reuse, then smallest number.
candidate_definition.execution: Runtime-only replacement of current_priorities for the pilot; no production file edited.

limits: Exploratory related prefixes, not independent random samples or universal correctness evidence.
A real regression is retained; this priority does not dominate the baseline.
Four is an input palette. A solved output is checked, not an existence proof for arbitrary drawings.
The manual target-case witness is distinct from the automatic candidate output.
No coloring assignments, alternative histories, or retry branches are enumerated by the candidate.

target_audit.manual_completion_note: Manually supplied separate witness, not the algorithm output.

conditional_hall_audit.scope: Conditional deduction after retaining the FIRST TWO OLD decisions; not a fresh tight-hall policy run.
conditional_hall_audit.coordinate_system: x-right, y-down; bounds=[x0,y0,x1,y1], outside has no finite region bounds
conditional_hall_audit.trace_note: Rows without rule are base singleton propagation; all Hall reservations retain their contemporaneous subset domains.

independent_trace_replay.method: Initialize domains from the saved dart anchors; independently reconstruct actual adjacency from plane edges; replay every singleton or Hall-reservation certificate, checking then-current domains, true clique adjacency, union size, exact removed names, final domains, and every final inequality.
